whatIs: Arc UI is a library of animated React components and blocks, designed for projects with shadcn/ui and Next.js. You add them with the shadcn CLI (for example, npx shadcn@latest add @uiarc/button), which copies the source code into your project so you can edit it however you like.

It also offers an MCP server, so an AI agent like Claude Code can find and install pieces for you. It's a good fit when you want an interface with polished motion without writing every animation by hand.
uses: Building a landing page with ready-made animated sections and blocks.
Adding buttons, cards and other components with motion to an app that already uses shadcn/ui.
Asking an AI agent to install and combine components through the MCP server.
caveats: There's a Pro plan: the more elaborate motion components and most of the full blocks are paid.
The code is copied into your project, so you apply future updates yourself.
The Pro license doesn't allow reselling or redistributing the code, for example in templates or UI kits.
pricingNote: Free under the MIT license for the basic components; Pro is paid yearly or as a one-time purchase.
idealFor: React projects with shadcn/ui that want ready-made animated interfaces.
